_topic: Acid House / TB-303。デジタルブック第3章。誰も欲しがらなかった失敗作の機械から、UKレイブが生まれた。

slides.sub: born from a machine nobody wanted
The TB-303. 1981. Meant to replace a bass guitarist.
Discontinued in three years. A commercial failure.
Chicago, 1987. Phuture found the squelch by accident.

slides.note: Acid was born from a machine nobody wanted.

slides.sub: 1988, Britain. Warehouses. Fields. A new world every weekend.
The face of a generation that found ecstasy — in every sense.
